features.title: User Authentication
features.description: Implement JWT-based authentication for users and librarians with secure token management and expiration mechanisms.
user_stories: As a user, I want to log in using my credentials so that I can access the library system.
As a librarian, I want to log in using my credentials so that I can manage the library inventory.
acceptance_criteria: JWT-based authentication must be implemented for both users and librarians.
Tokens should expire after 24 hours for users and 7 days for librarians.
Refresh tokens should be supported to allow long-term sessions.

features.title: Book Management
features.description: Allow librarians to add, update, and delete book records with support for multiple formats and genres.
user_stories: As a librarian, I want to add new books to the inventory so that they are available for borrowing.
As a librarian, I want to update existing book records so that information is accurate.
As a librarian, I want to delete books from the inventory when they are no longer available.
acceptance_criteria: Librarians should be able to add new books with valid ISBNs and titles/author names up to 256 characters.
Existing book records can be updated with new information, including format and genre.
Books can be deleted from the inventory when they are no longer available.

features.title: Borrowing & Returning Books
features.description: Enable users to borrow books with a due date, implement automated reminders for overdue items, and allow returning books with extension options.
user_stories: As a user, I want to borrow books so that I can read them.
As a user, I want to receive reminders when my book is due so that I don't forget to return it.
As a user, I want to extend the loan period of my borrowed books if applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Users should be able to borrow books with a due date set for 14 days from the borrowing date.
Automated daily email/SMS reminders should be sent 24 hours before the due date for overdue items.
Users should be allowed to extend the loan period up to 2 weeks from the due date.

features.title: Search Functionality
features.description: Provide search capabilities by title, author, ISBN, and genre with support for advanced search options.
user_stories: As a user, I want to search for books by title so that I can find the book I am looking for.
As a user, I want to search for books by author so that I can discover new works by my favorite authors.
As a user, I want to search for books by ISBN so that I can verify ownership of a book.
As a user, I want to search for books by genre so that I can explore different types of literature.
acceptance_criteria: Search functionality should be available by title, author, ISBN, and genre.
Advanced search options should include filtering by availability, format, genre, and publication year.

features.title: Librarian Dashboard
features.description: Display real-time book inventory status, show user borrowing history and overdue items, and allow librarians to manage user accounts and requests.
user_stories: As a librarian, I want to see the current inventory status so that I can manage stock levels.
As a librarian, I want to view user borrowing history so that I can track book usage.
As a librarian, I want to manage user accounts so that I can add/remove/update user details.
As a librarian, I want to process user requests for loans and returns.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time inventory status should display available/checked-out books.
User borrowing history should include borrow date, due date, return date (if applicable).
Librarians should be able to add/remove/update user details including name, email, and role.
Librarians should be able to approve/deny book loan requests.

features.title: Reporting & Analytics
features.description: Generate reports on library usage, popular books, and user activity with an analytics dashboard for administrators.
user_stories: As a librarian or administrator, I want to generate reports on library usage so that I can understand borrowing trends.
As a librarian or administrator, I want to see popular books by title/author so that I can promote them.
As a librarian or administrator, I want to track user activity such as number of borrows per month/user.
acceptance_criteria: Reports should include library usage data, popular books, and user activity trends.
An analytics dashboard should be provided for administrators with real-time data visualization and historical trends.

features.title: User Notifications
features.description: Send email or SMS notifications for overdue items and book availability changes.
user_stories: As a user, I want to receive reminders when my book is due so that I don't forget to return it.
As a user, I want to be notified when a borrowed book becomes available again.
acceptance_criteria: Email/SMS notifications should be sent 24 hours before the due date for overdue items.
Users should be notified when a borrowed book is available again.

features.title: Integration with Existing Systems
features.description: Support integration with existing library management systems (e.g., Koha) and provide APIs for data exchange.
user_stories: As a system administrator, I want to integrate the Library Management System API with existing library management systems so that we can synchronize book/user data.
acceptance_criteria: The API should support bi-directional synchronization of book/user data with existing library management systems.
Data exchange APIs should be provided for seamless integration between the system and other applications.
